meta.name: cqrs-implementation
meta.description: Implement Command Query Responsibility Segregation for scalable architectures. Use when separating read and write models, optimizing query performance, or building event-sourced systems.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实现CQRS架构，分离读写模型以提升系统扩展性
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在设计或重构后端架构,需要分离读写模型来应对高并发查询。
copy.tagline_en: Implement CQRS to separate read and write models for scalable architectures.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're designing or refactoring backend architecture to handle high-concurrency reads and writes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 CQRS 模式帮你设计系统：把命令（写操作）和查询（读操作）分开，用事件同步两侧数据，并提供模板、最佳实践和具体示例。
howto.when: 当你提到要分离读写模型、优化查询性能或构建事件溯源系统时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 CQRS 模式设计订单系统的读写分离
say.note: Claude 会给出命令/查询拆分和事件同步方案

say.text: 我的报表查询很慢，怎么用 CQRS 优化？
say.note: Claude 会指导你建立独立的读模型

say.text: 给我一个事件溯源系统的 CQRS 实现步骤
say.note: Claude 会从事件模型到投影器逐步说明

howto.what_en: Claude will help design systems using CQRS by separating commands (writes) and queries (reads), syncing the two sides with events, and providing templates, best practices, and worked examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to separate read and write models, optimize query performance, or build event-sourced systems.

say_en.text: Help me design an order system with CQRS read/write separation.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a command/query split and event sync plan.

say_en.text: My reporting queries are slow; how can CQRS help?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you in setting up a dedicated read model.

say_en.text: Show me steps to implement CQRS in an event-sourced system.
say_en.note: Claude explains from event model to projectors.
